organizations.name: Black Mamas Matter Alliance
organizations.eligibility: Anyone; focused on Black maternal health
organizations.what_they_help_with: Black maternal health advocacy, rights education, and connections to birth workers, doulas, and community care networks.

organizations.name: National Maternal Mental Health Hotline
organizations.eligibility: Anyone pregnant or within a year after birth; free, 24/7, English and Spanish
organizations.what_they_help_with: Free confidential support before, during, and after pregnancy — counselors who take your concerns seriously.

organizations.name: HRSA Find a Health Center (FQHCs)
organizations.eligibility: Everyone — fees on a sliding scale; no one turned away for inability to pay; no immigration status requirement
organizations.what_they_help_with: Locator for community health centers offering primary care, prenatal care, dental, and mental health regardless of insurance.

organizations.name: HHS Office for Civil Rights
organizations.eligibility: Anyone discriminated against by a health provider or insurer that receives federal funds
organizations.what_they_help_with: Federal complaints about discrimination in healthcare — race, disability, sex, language access. Free; no lawyer needed; 180-day deadline.

organizations.name: Patient Advocate Foundation
organizations.eligibility: Patients with chronic, life-threatening, or debilitating conditions
organizations.what_they_help_with: Free case managers who fight insurance denials, billing problems, and access-to-care issues on your behalf.
